text:
julia: tiny news drop  two things: accepted Senior PM role and were expecting a baby in January!!! :tada: :baby: :sparkles:
nate: WHAT!! double congrats!!!!!! so many reasons to celebrate 970
sasha: omg julia, thats incredible. we should absolutely do a little office thing. poll: react :mooncake: for afternoon snacks (mooncakes + tea) or :cupcake: for cupcakes at lunch.
omar: mooncakes? unique. i'm in for whatever. also can we make one dairy-free and nut-free?
julia: thank you all i love the mooncake idea (family tradition). allergy note: im allergic to cashews, so nut-free please. dairy okay.
people-ops-bot: Promo logged: Julia promoted to Senior PM. Swag tier unlocked. $175 celebratory budget allocated. Please DM People Ops to confirm gifts vs donation.
bakery-bot: Bakery options available: 1) Traditional mooncakes (lotus paste) 2) Snow-skin dairy-free fruit mooncakes (nut-free option) 3) Assorted cupcakes. Delivery windows: Thu 11:30 or Thu 15:00. Reply with option number and pickup time.
sasha: 2) Snow-skin dairy-free fruit mooncakes at 15:00 please. sounds perfect and keeps it desk-friendly.
omar: adding a savory option? i'll bring a steamed bao tray for lunch.
nate: i can bring a tiny eucalyptus plant for the baby (succulent alternative?). julia preference?
julia: eucalyptus sounds lovely but low-shedding is best (we live in a condo). small potted fern would be perfect. thanks!
sasha: vote check  react :mooncake: if youre for afternoon mooncake tea, :cupcake: for lunch cupcakes.
omar: :mooncake:
nate: :mooncake:
sasha: :mooncake:
julia: :mooncake:

calendar-bot: Event created: "Julia promo + baby mini-tea" Thu 15:00-15:30 Kitchen Island. Zoom added for remote colleagues. Invite sent to channel.
bakery-bot: Order confirmed: Snow-skin fruit mooncakes (nut-free) delivery Thu 14:50. Invoice sent to organizer.
omar: i'll pick up the bao at 14:15. nate can you bring the fern?
nate: yes Ill bring the fern and a tiny card. also remote folks, please drop short clips if you want included.
julia: youre all making my week. cant wait to celebrate with you (and introduce baby bump, eventually) heart
